claims.says: Name resolution succeeds exactly on visible names: comprehension locals, the current clause scope, or, only while a projection's ORDER BY, WHERE, SKIP or LIMIT is bound, the pre-projection scope.
A successful name resolution returns the innermost binding: comprehension locals first, then the clause scope, then the pre-projection scopes, copying a parent variable at id equal to the table size.
Inserting, under a name not yet in a scope table, a fresh variable whose id is the table size keeps every id in the table below the table size.
If every inline property map in a pattern only reads variables bound before the clause, both the binder's nodes-first binding order and textual order accept the pattern.
Whenever bind-time constant folding turns an expression tree into a value, evaluating that tree at runtime gives the same value, whatever the non-literal parts evaluate to.
